title: The city parade
alt: A crowded modern city street parade with dancers and spectators. Cbear in his navy scarf is tucked in the crowd on the left.

finds.label: Gold trumpet
finds.spoken: Find the gold trumpet on the bench.

finds.label: White mask
finds.spoken: Find the white mask on the left.

finds.label: Purple ribbon
finds.spoken: Find the purple ribbon on the basket.

finds.label: Green parasol
finds.spoken: Find the green parasol on the right.

finds.label: Red toy horse
finds.spoken: Find the red toy horse on the right.

sounds.text: See the mask. Hear m in mask.
sounds.spoken: See the mask. Hear the m sound in mask.

words.text: Look for the red toy horse. Sound out red.
words.spoken: Look for the red toy horse. Sound out red: r, e, d.

digraphs.text: Look by the shop. Hear sh in shop.
digraphs.spoken: Look by the shop. Hear sh in shop.

hint: Search the left side of the crowd, below the black street lamp.
